text:
Plant Care Specialist chat runs 9am-5pm Mon-Fri (your local time), so they aren't available on a Saturday afternoon. The next chance is Monday from 9am. In the meantime, you can email help@leafy.example for specialist advice, and you'll get a reply within 1 business day. Our general chat team is on until 8pm today, but they can't give specialist plant advice.

Overwatering is the most common cause of early problems, so water only when the top inch of soil is dry. If the plant is within its 30-day guarantee (90 days for Leafy Plus members) and is declining significantly, you can also file a claim from "My Orders" with two photos (whole plant and a close-up).
